parsed.note_claim: The regular Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train was struck by a drone, while politicians like Boris Johnson and Günter Sautter were on a separate chartered train that stopped nearby as a precaution.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Eine russische Drohne hat am Sonntagmorgen die Lokomotive des internationalen Passagierzugs von Kiew nach Warschau getroffen. [...] musste ein privat gecharterter Sonderzug unweit der Grenze stoppen. [...] An Bord befanden sich demnach Günter Sautter [...] sowie der frühere britische Premierminister Boris Johnson.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms both that the regular Kyiv-Warsaw passenger train was struck by a Russian drone and that Johnson and Sautter were on a separately chartered train that stopped near the border.
